title: Automate Your CapCut Editing With Claude (Step by Step + Free Skill)
fulltitle: Automate Your CapCut Editing With Claude (Step by Step + Free Skill)
description:
Sign up for Higgsfield here: https://higgsfield.ai/s/mattloui-kBNuih

Claude edited this entire CapCut video. 117 cuts on my talking head, motion graphics, music, zooms and a colour grade, and I didn't edit a single thing. It's all built in a real CapCut project, so you can still tweak anything before you export.

In this Claude + CapCut tutorial, I'll show you my full workflow step by step: the exact prompt that edits your CapCut project, connecting the Higgsfield MCP so Claude can make motion graphics from a Pinterest reference, adding your human touch, and turning the whole process into a Claude skill you can reuse on every edit.

Serious about CapCut editing? Click here: https://mattloui.com/?cl=DD4EAM79

Get my free Claude skill: https://drive.google.com/file/d/103y1YEyfLMY-sPQOm8Hpv97fvxxZOM4V/view?usp=sharing

Copy the full prompts list: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qtpbmYCOSuxu_bOT7M5emp1r2YkZAE6Pg5S6RIq--I4/edit?usp=sharing

What you need:
- CapCut desktop (CapCut Web won't work)
- Claude desktop app on Claude Pro ($17/month on the annual plan, $20 month to month)
- A Higgsfield subscription to connect the MCP (Starter is $15/month)

The motion graphics cost $0 in credits, because Claude wrote every one of them as code. I break down the full cost at 8:43.

Heads up: your first project takes Claude around 3 hours to finish (only about 10 minutes of that is you). Once your skill is installed, it's much faster.
